dct_title_s: Yemen Subnational Population and Housing Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on National Census and Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first- and second-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided. The tabular data contain total population for 2004 (census) and 2016 (population estimates), as well as five-year age group and sex, and information relating to IDPs and refugees, households, housing, income and poverty, information and communication technology, and health.
